meaning: Defaults to running ~1000 cardiac cycles of pulsatile pre-simulation so each m5 run starts on its limit cycle instead of a transient. Setting `_M5_LIMIT_CYCLE=0` skips that and yields transient runs.

could_move.what: Pulsatile initial state of every m5 run, hence any pulse amplitude or phase read off it
Agreement between the pulsatile route and the mean-level route that verify_fit.jl enforces
All comparison decks, since an unseeded run is stated not to be comparable with fitted numbers
Numbers reported in the fitting report for the patient decks

expectation: With the seed on (default), pulsatile output should be cycle-periodic. With it off, expect a drifting first-cycles transient. The size of the offset cannot be inferred from the code alone.

check.why: verify_fit.jl already checks the mean-level route against the pulsatile baseline, so one verify pass exercises the seeding without a re-fit.
